question: Should this repository adopt the proposed Vincent-only bootstrap authority to reconcile Cloudflare Access and publish generation-bound credentials across openclaw/clawsweeper and openclaw/gitcrawl-store before the slot-aware consumer is activated?
rationale: The patch can be technically sound while still creating a privileged production-adjacent authority whose operator identity, GitHub App scopes, Cloudflare permissions, and rollout order require explicit organizational approval.

options.title: Approve staged bootstrap
options.body: Approve the named-operator and cross-repository scopes, keep all consumers dormant, and merge after removing the release-owned changelog entry.

options.title: Narrow authority first
options.body: Require a different operator-authorization or GitHub App permission model before accepting the bootstrap workflow.

options.title: Defer to atomic cutover
options.body: Hold the bootstrap until the slot-aware consumer, verifier, migration, and credential rotation can be reviewed and landed together.

recommendation.title: Approve staged bootstrap
recommendation.body: Approve the named-operator and cross-repository scopes, keep all consumers dormant, and merge after removing the release-owned changelog entry.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposed authority is explicitly bound to this repository member's actor identity, making them the strongest available owner for explaining and confirming its operational boundary.
